job.job_description:
We are looking for a smart, proactive, and results-oriented Software Engineer to build elegant solutions for the insurance industrys complex business domain and make our industry-leading products even better.

You will have the opportunity to make an impact and contribute to a complex application suite of products, mission-critical to insurance companies.

Bachelors degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline.
Familiarity with OOPS concepts with Python is preferable.
Knowledge of Cloud platform and GenAI features is a plus.
Should be having zeal to learn new technologies.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
You will be trained on the existing Product architecture of different Verisk product offerings and technology solutions.
Contribute to the development, which may span across multiple products using Python and associated libraries, REST API development, AWS, GenAI, Data and Analytics use cases.
You will develop unit tests for newly implemented components.
Proactively contribute to software performance optimizations and continuous improvements to code quality, robustness and development processes
Prepare documentations and specifications.
Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
